When you’re buying a car for business, the sticker price is only part of the equation.

Which is why, when considering the MG M9 or MG Cyberster, the smarter question isn’t just “What does it cost?”

It’s “What does it really cost me?”

#MGM9 #MGCyberster #MGSelect #TaxPlanning #BusinessOwners CostOfOwnership".

743 likes, 400 comments - rohitjoshi.ig on August 19, 2026: "Credit card arbitrage is basically using the interest-free credit period of a card to temporarily deploy your own cash elsewhere.

For example: You spend ₹1 lakh on a credit card, keep your ₹1 lakh in a liquid/short-term instrument during the billing cycle, and repay the card in full before the due date. The return earned during that period becomes your arbitrage gain.

The key is: no interest, no late fees, and no unnecessary transaction charges—otherwise the arbitrage can quickly disappear.".

2,130 likes, 340 comments - tejasjosh.i on August 16, 2026: "Balloon financing can make your car EMI look much smaller by pushing a large part of the payment to the end. 🎈🚗

Brands like BMW and Mercedes-Benz offer financing structures with this kind of final-payment model.

The catch? You’ll have a sizeable payment waiting at the end of the loan. You may need to pay it, refinance it, or—in some plans—return/upgrade the car subject to the terms.".
